selected_skill.selection_reason: High-star academic skill available locally; its paper-analysis and literature-review workflow maps directly to claim verification, bibliography cleaning, and evidence synthesis.

environment_design.realistic_chain: Input manuscript claims and noisy BibTeX records must be checked against a local HTTP scholarly metadata and abstract gateway.
environment_design.data_determinism: Evidence gateway serves a fixed snapshot from evidence_snapshot.json with stable paper metadata, abstracts, findings, duplicate records, and unverified records.
environment_design.with_without_skill_control: The with_skill and without_skill variants must differ only by presence or removal of environment/skills and the corresponding runtime copy logic.

main_tests: per-source research design and methodological limitation assessment
guardrail_tests: local evidence gateway snapshot health check
forbidden fake/out-of-scope sources excluded from final outputs
all evidence keys resolve to accepted BibTeX entries

experiment_plan.oracle: Run solution/solve.sh in the task container and require full verifier pass.
experiment_plan.skill_effect: Run at least three valid E2B task-level trials each for with_skill and without_skill using codex + gpt-5.4; only environment/skills differs.
experiment_plan.readme: Fill README.md after oracle and comparison results are available.

codex_gpt54_comparison.control_diff_check: No differences outside environment/skills in the r4 runtime pair.
